name: scheduler-sql
title: Scheduled prompts: jobs at a time or on a cron schedule, kept in storage.sql
description: The scheduler: jobs that run a prompt at a time or on a cron schedule (5 fields, in a time zone) in a conversation that exists, kept in storage.sql and woken by wakeups; each tick delivered at least once, with a policy for ticks missed while stopped.

scheduler.summary: Jobs that run a prompt in a conversation at a time or on a cron schedule: keep, list and cancel them, and handle their ticks.
